figurative_meaning_en: To leave a lasting impact or exert effective influence
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ঘটনা আমার জীবনে দাগ কাটবে।
example_sentences_in_english: His work has made a mark in society.
This incident will leave a lasting impact on my life.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to engraving or imprinting something indelibly, drawing from the idea of cutting a visible mark on a surface.
